$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the General section's Agent Chat defaults for new chats (cx-d5b5d). scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants from it (its docstring is the row format); schemas/settings/settings-schema.json is still exported from Swift and must not change when rows move here.

lists.name: agentDefaults
lists.note: The defaults a new agent chat starts with (Agents > Agent Chat).

rows.name: permissionMode
rows.note: acpmux reads it at each new chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/hub/start_mode.rs): a mode picked in a chat applies to that chat only (Leo 2026-10-21). A value MDM or the team policy forces reaches acpmux through the app's settings push (ChatSettings) and wins over the settings file.

help.text: What a new chat may do without asking. A mode you pick in a chat applies to that chat only.

rows.note: How long Claude Code keeps a chat's prompt cached. acpmux reads it at each Claude Code start (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/prompt_cache_env.rs).

help.text: One hour keeps replies after a pause cheap; its cache writes cost a little more.

rows.name: agentEnv
rows.note: Variables every agent chat gets, as Claude Code's env setting and Codex's shell_environment_policy.set. acpmux reads it at each chat start (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/agent_env.rs): a value the profile, preset, route, session or login shell sets wins; a remote-origin chat gets none.

help.text: Variables every new chat's agent and its tools get. A value an agent profile already sets wins.

rows.name: agentEnvExclude
rows.note: Variable names (or PREFIX_*) no agent chat gets, as Codex's shell_environment_policy.exclude. acpmux removes them last when it builds the agent's command (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/agent_env.rs); its own ACPMUX_* session wiring stays.

help.text: Variable names agents never get, such as AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_*.

rows.name: additionalDirectories
rows.note: Folders every new chat gets on top of its Sources, as Claude Code's additionalDirectories setting: Claude Code --add-dir, ACP additionalDirectories. acpmux adds them at chat creation (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/hub/additional_dirs.rs); a folder that is not there is skipped; a remote-origin chat gets none.

help.text: Added to every new chat's Sources. Use full or ~/ paths.

rows.name: sandboxMode
rows.note: acpmux reads it at each new chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/agent_sandbox.rs). permissionMode (default, what acpmux did before): the sandbox follows the permission mode; the Codex bridge's modes carry their own sandbox_mode (ask and agent workspace-write, read-only read-only, agent-full-access danger-full-access) and Claude Code runs without its sandbox. workspaceWrite: full-access modes are off, as with sessions.allowFullAccess off, so Codex never runs danger-full-access; Claude Code starts with --settings sandbox.enabled true and sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCommands false, merged into the launch's own inline --settings (its sandbox covers Bash). A remote-origin chat keeps its own sandbox.

help.text: Workspace Only keeps agents' writes inside their workspace and turns full-access modes off.

rows.name: sandboxNetwork
rows.note: acpmux reads it at each new chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/agent_sandbox.rs). harness (default, what acpmux did before): each harness's own; Codex's workspace-write sandbox has no network, Claude Code's sandbox asks per domain. allow: the codex app-server launch gets -c sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true unless its command line or codex's config sets that key; a mode switched to mid-chat uses the bridge's own policy, which has no network. Claude Code's network rules stay its own. A remote-origin chat keeps its own.

help.text: Allow lets Codex's workspace sandbox reach the network.

rows.name: claudeOutputStyle
rows.note: Claude Code's outputStyle for the chats cmux starts; acpmux puts it in the launch's one --settings at each Claude Code start (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/agent_launch_choices.rs). agent (the default) passes nothing, so Claude Code's own settings decide; a --settings of the profile's that names outputStyle keeps its value.

help.text: The output style new Claude Code chats use. Agent’s Own keeps Claude Code’s setting.

rows.name: codexPersonality
rows.note: Codex's personality config for the chats cmux starts; acpmux passes it as -c personality="..." at each codex app-server start (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/agent_launch_choices.rs). The values are the ones codex accepts (codex 0.171: none, friendly, pragmatic). agent (the default) passes nothing, so Codex's own config decides; a -c personality of the profile's keeps its value.

help.text: The personality new Codex chats use. Agent’s Own keeps Codex’s setting.

rows.name: commitAttribution
rows.note: strip gives Claude Code attribution {commit: "", pr: ""} in the launch's one --settings at each Claude Code start (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/agent_launch_choices.rs), so its commits and pull requests carry no co-author line. Claude Code only: Codex has no config for its attribution (codex 0.171 follows the ChatGPT workspace's policy). agent (the default) passes nothing; a --settings of the profile's that names attribution or includeCoAuthoredBy keeps its value.

title.text: Co-Author Line on Commits and PRs

help.text: Remove leaves Claude Code’s co-author line and footer off commits and pull requests. Codex has no such setting.

rows.name: claudeCodeInboxRelay
rows.note: Off by default: acpmux never edits Claude Code's config unasked (desktop_link's rule). On, the first time acpmux delivers a message into a Claude Code chat that runs no inbox relay, it adds the tool-less cmux-inbox MCP server to Claude Code's user config (claude mcp add-json --scope user), so later chats write acpmux's deliveries themselves and Claude Code does not hold them (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/desktop_link.rs ensure_inbox_relay_once, read at each delivery). acpmux desktop link adds the same relay by hand (Leo 2026-11-20, ask-4f683bf7d8).

title.text: Add Message Relay to Claude Code

help.text: Adds a small server to Claude Code's settings so messages from other agents arrive without being held. Applies to Claude Code chats started afterwards.

rows.name: claudeDefaultModel
rows.note: The model a new Claude Code chat starts on when the chat names none. acpmux reads it at each new chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/model_settings.rs, hub/start_defaults.rs): above config.json defaults (a pick in a chat), below a per-chat pick, a preset, a folder profile or a profile's own model. Empty: today's chain (the last pick, the CLI's own config, the catalog default).

title.text: Claude Code Model for New Chats

help.text: A model id such as claude-opus-5-5. Empty starts on the last model you picked.

rows.name: claudeDefaultEffort
rows.note: The reasoning effort a new Claude Code chat starts on when the chat names none; acpmux reads it at each new chat (model_settings.rs, hub/start_defaults.rs), in the same order as the model row. An effort the starting model lacks is skipped. auto: today's chain.

title.text: Claude Code Effort for New Chats

help.text: How hard a new chat thinks. Last Used keeps the last effort you picked.

rows.name: codexDefaultModel
rows.note: The model a new Codex chat starts on when the chat names none. acpmux reads it at each new chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/model_settings.rs, hub/start_defaults.rs): above config.json defaults (a pick in a chat), below a per-chat pick, a preset, a folder profile or a profile's own model. Empty: today's chain (the last pick, the CLI's own config, the catalog default).

help.text: A model id such as gpt-6.2-sol. Empty starts on the last model you picked.

rows.name: codexDefaultEffort
rows.note: The reasoning effort a new Codex chat starts on when the chat names none; acpmux reads it at each new chat (model_settings.rs, hub/start_defaults.rs), in the same order as the model row. An effort the starting model lacks is skipped. auto: today's chain.

help.text: How hard a new chat thinks. Last Used keeps the last effort you picked.

rows.name: textGenerationModel
rows.note: The Claude model that writes cmux's generated text: chat titles, task names, rolling summaries and diff hunk summaries (every _acpmux/complete that names no model and runs on Claude Code, cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/hub/complete.rs and hub/titles.rs, read through model_settings.rs). acpmux config titles.model / summaries.model still win. cmux NEXT writes no commit messages or PR text with a model. Default haiku, the small model these ran on before the row.

help.text: The Claude model that writes chat titles and summaries.

rows.name: claudeProviderPath
rows.note: The program acpmux starts for the built-in Claude Code (claude) in place of the one on PATH. Read at each start of the provider's chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/provider_settings.rs); a harness profile of the person's own (cmux harness add) keeps its own. Empty: today's launch.

help.text: The Claude Code program new chats run. Empty uses the one on your PATH.

rows.name: claudeProviderHome
rows.note: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR for the built-in Claude Code; a bound account's own home still wins. Read at each start of the provider's chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/provider_settings.rs); a harness profile of the person's own (cmux harness add) keeps its own. Empty: today's launch.

help.text: Where Claude Code keeps its settings and sign-in (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR). Empty uses ~/.claude.

rows.name: claudeProviderArgs
rows.note: Extra arguments after the built-in Claude Code launch, before a preset's. Read at each start of the provider's chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/provider_settings.rs); a harness profile of the person's own (cmux harness add) keeps its own. Empty: today's launch.

help.text: Arguments added when cmux starts Claude Code, one per entry.

rows.name: claudeProviderEnv
rows.note: Environment for the built-in Claude Code, over config.json's defaults.claude.env; a preset's and the session's env win. Secrets go in cmux harness secret, never this file. Not agents.env (every agent's). Read at each start of the provider's chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/provider_settings.rs); a harness profile of the person's own (cmux harness add) keeps its own. Empty: today's launch.

help.text: Variables Claude Code starts with. Keep keys and tokens out: use cmux harness secret.

rows.name: codexProviderPath
rows.note: The codex binary the built-in Codex bridge runs (its CODEX_PATH) in place of the one on PATH. Read at each start of the provider's chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/provider_settings.rs); a harness profile of the person's own (cmux harness add) keeps its own. Empty: today's launch.

help.text: The Codex program new chats run. Empty uses the one on your PATH.

rows.name: codexProviderHome
rows.note: CODEX_HOME for the built-in Codex; a bound account's own home still wins. Read at each start of the provider's chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/provider_settings.rs); a harness profile of the person's own (cmux harness add) keeps its own. Empty: today's launch.

help.text: Where Codex keeps its settings and sign-in (CODEX_HOME). Empty uses ~/.codex.

rows.name: codexProviderArgs
rows.note: Extra arguments after the built-in Codex launch, before a preset's. Read at each start of the provider's chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/provider_settings.rs); a harness profile of the person's own (cmux harness add) keeps its own. Empty: today's launch.

help.text: Arguments added when cmux starts Codex, one per entry.

rows.name: codexProviderEnv
rows.note: Environment for the built-in Codex, over config.json's defaults.codex.env; a preset's and the session's env win. Secrets go in cmux harness secret, never this file. Not agents.env (every agent's). Read at each start of the provider's chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/provider_settings.rs); a harness profile of the person's own (cmux harness add) keeps its own. Empty: today's launch.

help.text: Variables Codex starts with. Keep keys and tokens out: use cmux harness secret.

lists.name: agentTools
lists.note: Settings > Agents > cmux Tools: whether agents the person starts in cmux (its terminals and agent chats) get cmux's MCP server (on by default), beside the card that lists the agents on this Mac, an old cmux entry in one's own config (with Remove) and the manual lines for agents started elsewhere.

rows.name: cmuxMcp
rows.note: Whether agents cmux starts get its cmux MCP server (cmux mcp serve, which carries cmux Computer Use): a Claude Code or Codex typed into a cmux terminal (the claude and codex shims, cmux-tui agent_mcp_choice.rs) and the app's agent chats (acpmux agent_tools.rs agents_get_cmux), all with one server definition named cmux (acpmux agent_tools::cmux_server) and the app's settings file. Only through the launch: cmux never writes an agent's own config; cmux setup mcp reports which agents get it and the manual lines a person runs to use it elsewhere. on (the default, also unset or any value but off: cmux's tools come with the app) gives the server (it also turns the server on for these agents unless mcp.enabled says otherwise, cli/mcp/config.rs); off gives none. A Chief turn keeps its own cmux tool list either way. Rust reads it with cmux_tui_core::user_settings::AgentsCmuxMcp.

help.text: Agents you start in cmux get cmux’s tools, Computer Use included: Claude Code and Codex in cmux’s terminals and agent chats. cmux never changes your agents’ own settings.

summary.text: Whether agents you start in cmux get cmux’s tools

rows.name: cmuxMcpClaude
rows.note: Per-agent switch under agents.cmuxMcp (cmux#49395): off keeps cmux's MCP server from Claude Code started in cmux (the claude shim, cmux-tui AgentsCmuxMcp::current_for; an agent chat, acpmux agent_tools::agent_switch_answer at spawn) even when the answer is on. On (the default) follows the answer. Settings > Agents writes it.

help.text: Off: Claude Code you start in cmux never gets cmux’s tools, even when they are on.

rows.name: cmuxMcpCodex
rows.note: Per-agent switch under agents.cmuxMcp (cmux#49395): off keeps cmux's MCP server from Codex started in cmux (the codex shim, cmux-tui AgentsCmuxMcp::current_for; an agent chat, acpmux agent_tools::agent_switch_answer at spawn) even when the answer is on. On (the default) follows the answer. Settings > Agents writes it.

help.text: Off: Codex you start in cmux never gets cmux’s tools, even when they are on.

rows.name: appControl
rows.note: Whether agents in cmux may change the app or only read it, enforced by the daemon (cmux-tui-core server/agent_app_control.rs): on read, every app-changing request from a process in a cmux terminal (socket-peer ancestry or its launch credential) or from an agent chat (its ACP launch credential) is refused with origin.forbidden reason agents_read_only: new workspaces, tabs and panes, input to terminals, moves, closes, renames, settings writes. Reads, streams and an agent's own reports (hooks, notifications, status) still work. change (unset) is today's behavior. A process outside cmux (another terminal app, the app itself) is the person's and is never refused. The daemon reads it in cmux-tui-core mux/settings.rs.

help.text: Read Only: agents in cmux’s terminals and agent chats can read cmux but not change it: no new workspaces, tabs or panes, no typing into other terminals, no settings changes.

summary.text: Whether agents in cmux may drive and change the app
